name: bug
description: Incorrect behavior with a reproducible or evidenced failure.

name: enhancement
description: A new capability or an improvement to existing behavior.

name: regression
description: Previously working behavior is broken; use together with bug.

name: documentation
description: Documentation, examples, or explanatory text as the primary outcome.

name: question
description: A usage question or a request for clarification.

name: priority:critical
description: Immediate action for an active widespread outage, credential exposure, or irreversible data loss.

name: priority:high
description: A confirmed major defect or a blocker for required validation or release.

name: priority:medium
description: Normal implementation or improvement work without demonstrated severe impact.

name: priority:low
description: A narrow improvement or documentation change that can safely wait.

name: area:codex
description: Codex Desktop integration, configuration, and client compatibility.

name: area:providers
description: Provider API adapters, protocol translation, and capability support.

name: area:routing
description: Local request routing, destination selection, and request lifecycle.

name: area:accounts
description: Account profiles, credential isolation, authentication, and account selection.

name: area:workflow
description: Repository conventions, issue and PR templates, labels, and development tooling.
